parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The name of the container field. Valid values:

*   **clusterId**: the ID of the cluster

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the container field.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The ID of the request source. Set the value to **sas**, which indicates that the request is sent from Security Center.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: MultiAccountActionType
parameters.description:
The type of the accounts that you want to query. Default value: **0**. Valid values:

*   **0**: the current account.
*   **1**: all accounts.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the alert type.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: SupportOperateCodeList
parameters.description: List of supported alarm operation types.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUIDs of servers. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).

> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-nsas-susp-event-type --source-ip 180.212.XX.XX --remark testECS --name Unusual_Logon --lang zh --from sas --uuids f56406cb-916d-42db-b6f7-2ff79e340000 --container-field-name clusterId --container-field-value ca3108551c83c4d949106e1ab9e1e0000 --multi-account-action-type 0 --support-operate-code-list AI.real_attack --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeNsasSuspEventType --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '180.212.XX.XX' --ContainerFieldName clusterId --ContainerFieldValue ca3108551c83c4d949106e1ab9e1e0000 --Lang zh --From sas --Uuids 'f56406cb-916d-42db-b6f7-2ff79e340000' --SupportOperateCodeList.1 'AI.real_attack' --Remark testECS --Name Unusual_Logon --MultiAccountActionType 0
